AdvancedRenderingConfig구조체dyf/RendererConfig.h선택한 고급 렌더 모듈의 설정이다. 표준 지오메트리와 HDR을 사용한다. 화면 공간 추적의 범위를 벗어난 반사는 EnvironmentLighting 모듈의 IBL을 사용한다.
BuildMeshLods함수dyf/Mesh.hTopology/normal/UV-aware indexed simplification. Leaves the input and vertex ordering unchanged; returns up to three additional levels.
Camera구조체dyf/Camera.h뷰 행렬·투영 행렬·월드 위치를 함께 보관하는 카메라입니다.
Canvas클래스dyf/Canvas.h2D 도형·이미지·UTF-8 텍스트 명령을 CPU에 모아 Renderer에 전달하는 캔버스입니다.

DrawIndirectArguments구조체dyf/RHI/Indirect.hGPU-visible argument layouts. An indirect command consumes exactly one structure at a 4-byte aligned byte offset in a BufferUsage::Indirect buffer. firstInstance must be zero unless Feature::IndirectFirstInstance is supported. Argument values may be GPU-written; the RHI does not read them back to validate.

Callback별칭dyf/Platform/Log.hInvoked on the logging thread, outside the output lock. Copy to retain a record. Stop logging workers before replacing/removing a callback or destroying its data. Exceptions are contained. Logging inside a callback does not invoke it recursively.
GetSessionDirectory함수dyf/Platform/Log.h설명 주석 없음
Initialize함수dyf/Platform/Log.hAutomatic on first log, Window creation or Device creation. Settings are read once: DY_LOG_AUTO=0 disables automatic files/monitor; DY_LOG_DIR overrides the log root; DY_LOG_CRASH=0 disables crash monitoring; DY_LOG_MONITOR overrides the helper path. Native crash monitoring is Windows x64, from initialization onward. CMake's DY_LOG_CRASH_MONITOR deploys windows_monitor.exe beside applications on MSVC x64. Keep that helper beside packaged executables. Existing debuggers take precedence. Only common Log messages go to automatic files; arbitrary stdout/stderr is not captured.

확장: ImGui

API종류헤더설명
Gui클래스dyf/Extends/ImGui/ImGui.hLink dy_imgui (or dyf::ImGui) and include <imgui.h> for the widget API. One Gui/context on the window thread. Window and device must outlive Gui. Creates its own current ImGui context and chains the Window's GLFW callbacks; do not replace those callbacks while Gui is alive. Destruction restores them. Add fonts/glyph ranges before the first BeginFrame. That call submits the one-time atlas upload. Fonts and atlas are immutable afterwards (legacy mode). Docking may be enabled by the application; secondary OS viewports are unsupported. Unregistered texture IDs and draw callbacks other than ResetRenderState are rejected.
